sourceCodeManifest.description: Empty package init for the client_portal Django app
Empty package init for the domain sub-package
Pure Python enums and frozen dataclasses: ProjectStatus, MilestoneStatus, ApprovalStatus, InvoiceStatus, StakeholderRole, Money, FileMetadata, VersionNumber. Zero external dependencies.

Pure Python dataclass entities with invariant enforcement: ClientOrganization, UserProfile, Project (with state transition methods), Milestone, Deliverable, DeliverableVersion, Approval, FileRecord, MessageThread, Message, InvoiceRecord, ActivityEvent. No Django imports.

Frozen dataclass domain events (past-tense, immutable): ClientOrganizationRegistered, UserProfileCreated, ProjectActivated, ProjectSubmittedForApproval, ProjectReturnedToActive, ProjectCompleted, ProjectArchived, MilestoneStarted, MilestoneCompleted, DeliverableRevisionSubmitted, DeliverableApproved, DeliverableRejected, DeliverableRevisionRequested, FileRecordUploaded, MessagePosted, InvoiceSent, InvoicePaid, InvoiceMarkedOverdue.

Abstract repository interfaces (abc.ABC + abstractmethod) for all aggregates: ClientOrganizationRepository, UserProfileRepository, ProjectRepository, MilestoneRepository, DeliverableRepository, DeliverableVersionRepository, ApprovalRepository, FileRecordRepository, MessageThreadRepository, MessageRepository, InvoiceRecordRepository, ActivityEventRepository.

Django ORM persistence models (12 models): ClientOrganization, UserProfile, Project, Milestone, Deliverable, DeliverableVersion (supporting FK target for Approval/FileRecord), Approval, MessageThread (supporting FK target for Message), Message, FileRecord, InvoiceRecord, ActivityEvent. All fields use ubiquitous language. UUID primary keys throughout.
Auto-generated initial migration creating all 12 client_portal tables in the database.
Seed script: creates 2 ClientOrganization records, 3 Project records (ACTIVE/PENDING_APPROVAL/COMPLETE), and 1 OVERDUE InvoiceRecord. Idempotent via get_or_create.

unit.notes: Domain entity invariant logic (value_objects.py, model.py) is unit-testable without infrastructure. Unit tests are deferred to the QA phase per the pipeline design.

integration.notes: ORM model field definitions and FK relationships were verified by successful makemigrations and migrate execution. Formal integration test suite deferred to QA phase.

e2e.notes: No views or URL routes exist yet for client_portal in Phase 1. E2E tests deferred to subsequent phases.

testCoverageSummary.manualVerification: Seed script executed successfully: 2 ClientOrganization, 3 Project, and 1 InvoiceRecord (OVERDUE) created in the local SQLite database.

domain.notes: apps/client_portal/domain/ contains zero Django or third-party imports. All entities are pure Python dataclasses. Enums implemented as str+Enum per DDD conventions. Repository interfaces are pure ABCs.

infrastructure.notes: apps/client_portal/models.py contains only Django ORM models with no business logic in model methods. Status choices are defined as class-level constants, not inline strings. All FKs use named related_name values following the ubiquitous language.

layerComplianceSummary.dependencyDirection: Infrastructure (models.py) -> Domain layer boundary enforced: ORM models do not import from domain/. Domain layer does not import from Django. Clean Architecture dependency rule satisfied.

knownIssues.description: No admin.py registered for client_portal models. Django admin site will not surface these models until admin registration is added in a subsequent task.
No views.py or urls.py exist for client_portal. The app is registered and persisted but has no HTTP interface. URL routing is deferred to Phase 2.
DeliverableVersion and MessageThread are included as supporting ORM models (12 total instead of 10) because Approval and Message hold ForeignKeys to them. They are required for referential integrity.
